$description: fomo campus house tokens. The complete palette works across grid posts, stories, and web compositions. Choose colors by message, mood, and contrast, not by publishing format. Grid and story templates share six interchangeable colorways.

blue.$description: Campus purple. Primary identity color for the logo, large display text, and full-color canvases. The legacy blue token name remains for compatibility. Use deep ink #060510 for small text on this color, or white text on an ink panel.

electric.$description: Electric violet. A high-energy canvas or accent across grid posts, stories, and websites. Pair with white text.

highlight.$description: Lavender accent for text and decorative emphasis on ink. Available in both social formats and dark web compositions.

ink.$description: Campus ink. Dark canvas with white and lavender text, or high-contrast text on cyan, lavender, and white. Use deep ink #060510 for small text on campus purple. Available across formats.

pale.$description: Soft lavender. Light canvas for ink text with campus purple display accents. Use action purple for small colored text. Available across formats.

white.$description: Studio white. Light canvas for ink text and campus purple display type, or text on electric violet and ink. Available across formats.

action.$description: Action purple. For small colored text on white or soft lavender, and button fills with white text.

purple.$description: Campus purple. Preferred human name and alias for the legacy core.blue token. Available across grid posts, stories, and websites.

signal.$description: Signal cyan. Canvas with ink text, or a large accent on ink. Available for grid posts, stories, and web campaign accents.

canvas.$description: Legacy black canvas retained for existing assets. New social compositions can use any of the six shared colorways.

deepViolet.$description: Deep violet. The dark end of the electric campaign gradient and a dark atmospheric surface. Pair with white.

rewardCyan.$description: Reward cyan. Large emphasis only, for a reward or milestone figure on electric, deep violet, or ink. Use white for small text. Does not replace signal cyan #0099F7.

family.$description: House default. Recent campaign use of Poppins ExtraBold is a campaign exception.

story.description: House safe-area guidance; interface overlays vary. Confirm the final preview in the destination app.

socialColorways.$description: One palette, two interchangeable formats. Grid posts and stories allow the same six themes; campaign content and identity do not change when the format changes.
socialColorways.contrastRule: Keep the text and canvas pairings together. Campus purple uses white for large display type and the mark, with deep ink #060510 for small text. Cyan uses ink; electric violet uses white. On white or soft lavender, use action purple for small colored text.

campaignAtmosphere.$description: The electric campaign surface: an electric-to-deep-violet gradient with one soft white glow. Each campaign colorway below has its own atmosphere within the same rules.
rules: Keep the gradient within electric violet #4A36FF and deep violet #3521D4 when white small text sits directly on the surface.
Use one broad, soft white glow with opacity no higher than 8%; do not stack glows or add brightness effects.
Atmosphere belongs behind content. Keep the official wordmark and campus cap flat, sharp, proportionate, and free of shadows or blur.

Use reward cyan for large emphasis only: at least 24 CSS px regular or 19 CSS px bold in web use; the 1080px social templates should keep essential text at least 32px and make reward text much larger.
Keep small copy white. Verify contrast again if the color stops, glow strength, or blending changes.

contrastChecks.method: WCAG relative-luminance calculation; rounded to two decimals. The maximum-glow check uses the rounded sRGB composite #5846FF over the brightest electric endpoint.

campaignRecipes.$description: Six reusable campaign patterns: the chapter series (Heating Up Chapters, Top Chapters, Fastest Onboards), two milestones, and a chapter invite. Each works as a grid post or a story in any of the six campaign colorways. Bracketed text is an editable placeholder, never a live count, promise, or verified fact.

heating-up-chapters.name: Heating Up Chapters
structure: Tracked eyebrow and the Heating Up Chapters title with a flame
Five rows: school logo, school name, chapter name, chapter logo
rules: Use only approved school and chapter logos, in their own colors.
Shorten long school names (Penn State, not Pennsylvania State University).
Keep five rows. Split a longer list across carousel slides instead of shrinking them.

top-chapters.name: Top Chapters
structure: Tracked eyebrow and the Top Chapters title with a crown
Five ranked rows: rank, school logo, school name, chapter name, count
rules: Rank only on confirmed numbers from one reporting period, and name the period in the caption.
Say what the count measures in the column label.
Only the leader gets the panel and the emphasis color.

fastest-onboards.name: Fastest Onboards
structure: Tracked eyebrow and the Fastest Onboards title with a bolt
Five rows: school logo, school name, chapter name, time to onboard
rules: Define “onboarded” the same way every week and use confirmed times only.
Keep one time format across the rows, such as 2h 14m.
List the fastest first; it gets the filled tag.

growth-milestone.name: Growth milestone
rules: Confirm the figure, its definition, and the reporting period before posting.
Keep the number and its label together.
Never reuse a past figure as a current fact.

chapter-milestone.name: Chapter milestone
rules: Confirm the total and what counts as a participating chapter.
Do not reshape the campus mark or the eyes into numerals.

chapter-invite.name: Chapter invite
structure: Reward and goal in one translucent panel
rules: Fill [rate] and [total] only with an approved offer. State eligibility and the required action beside it.
Use the colorway's emphasis color for the reward figures only.
Remove the reward panel when there is no approved offer.

campaignMotion.$description: Optional motion for milestone cards. The motion specimen in the brand kit follows these values.
campaignMotion.behavior: Hold the full headline, steps, CTA, logos, and figures still and readable for at least 3 seconds per loop. If motion is used, move or fade the background atmosphere gently during the remaining time without changing its color bounds or exceeding the 8% glow cap.
campaignMotion.contentRule: Do not cycle unverified figures, replace facts, or animate a reward into a promise. Avoid flashing, rapid zooms, and character-by-character reading barriers.
campaignMotion.reducedMotion: Provide the complete static poster with the same text and hierarchy. Use it whenever reduced motion is requested and as the fallback where animation is unavailable.
campaignMotion.stillFirst: A static export remains valid for all four recipes.

campaignColorways.$description: All four campaign patterns are available in the same six colorways as the social templates. display is for large type, emphasis for the one focal figure, and text for everything below display size.
